domain_reasoning: The editor chiefly reads, evaluates and revises the manuscript's text.
length_reasoning: A short submission may take under an hour, while a long manuscript requiring substantive editing can take several days of active work.
review_reasoning: The reviewer reads the evaluation or samples changes against the original, with more checking needed for longer manuscripts.
stakes_reasoning: An overlooked editorial error can reach readers or require author rework, while serious factual or legal errors can be costly.

match_reasoning: OfficeVal includes restructuring and annotating existing documents, although it emphasizes specified file changes rather than editorial judgment on publication. GDPval also includes professional written deliverables but generally asks for a new deliverable rather than manuscript evaluation and editing.
best_difference: Document tasks emphasize specified changes rather than publication evaluation and editorial judgment.

domain_reasoning: Beyond talking, the supervisor typically looks up and updates customer records or transactions in service applications.
length_reasoning: Simple assistance can be resolved quickly, while escalated requests may require checking records and explaining several steps.
review_reasoning: A reviewer listens to the contact and checks relevant records, taking longer for complex requests.

domain_reasoning: The agent mainly uses scheduling, messaging and listing applications to coordinate a time.
